proposed_new_terms.definition: The design principle that no entry is ever modified after write; deletions are represented by omission or explicit removal. Core to cc's session persistence model.
The map that chains through consecutive legacy progress entries and rewrites subsequent messages' parentUuid to skip past them, maintaining chain integrity across entries no longer in the type union.
The optimization pattern of reading only the first and last 64KB of a JSONL file to extract metadata (first prompt, last title, last tag) without parsing the full content.
The practice of re-stamping provenance fields (sessionId, cwd, entrypoint, version) after message spreads to prevent cross-session contamination in forked or resumed sessions.
The pattern of unconditionally re-writing session metadata entries near EOF after compaction or on exit to keep them within the 64KB tail window for fast reads.
